Mk. 2 — Form 1: clean hits earn DIVINE CHARGE (0–20); being hit costs 2. Every 10 spent raises ATTUNEMENT (0–3). L tap = Railspear, hold 8f = L1 (8 Charge), hold 24f = L2 (12 Charge). ↓+O = Heaven's Array (6 Charge, 3 lines = Static Lock, 5 = Mark). P = Judgement Bolt (1 Mark + 5 Charge, strictly). R = Divine Execution at 10 / 15 / 20 Charge — 20 with Attunement 3 and a Mark is the full nine-strike execution.
Form 2 — PROXY OF THE CREATOR: the same chassis, overloaded. True immortality, a corrupted Charge readout, and a mission: kill before the blessing expires or The Creator says one word and erases you.
